brief: Customer support before vs after AI — ticket time dropped from hours to minutes.

slots.title: Stop wasting time
slots.description: AI handles the queue so your team solves tickets in minutes, not hours.

slots.title: Tickets sit untouched
slots.description: Repetitive requests flood the inbox while agents struggle to keep up daily.
slots.badText: Agents manually tag, sort, and route every incoming request by hand.
slots.goodText: AI instantly classifies and routes tickets to the right queue or agent.

slots.title: Customers wait forever
slots.description: Long wait times destroy trust and send users straight to your competitors.
slots.badText: First reply takes hours because agents are buried in backlogs.
slots.goodText: AI delivers accurate first responses in seconds, day or night.

slots.title: Support burns budget
slots.description: Human-only teams drive up labor costs with every new ticket that arrives.
slots.badText: Each ticket costs a fortune in agent hours and overhead.
slots.goodText: AI resolves the bulk of tickets without adding headcount.

slots.title: Answers are inconsistent
slots.description: Tired agents copy wrong details and breach tone or policy guidelines.
slots.badText: Mood and accuracy vary across shifts and individual agents.
slots.goodText: AI follows your knowledge base and brand voice precisely every time.

slots.title: Scaling means hiring
slots.description: Growing volume forces expensive recruiting and training cycles every quarter.
slots.badText: You hire three new agents just to survive the holiday rush.
slots.goodText: AI handles surges instantly while your team focuses on escalations.

slots.title: Customers leave angry
slots.description: Slow, poor support drives churn and destroys your brand reputation online.
slots.badText: Negative reviews pile up as frustrated users abandon ship.
slots.goodText: Fast, helpful AI turns users into loyal fans who stay longer.

slots.body: Join teams using AI to cut support costs and delight customers around the clock.
